map.阀门选型计算（Cv/Kv 流量系数） 使用指南: Valve Selection (Cv/Kv Flow Coefficient) User Guide
map.算法：相对密度 SG = 介质密度/1000；Kv = 流量×√(SG/压差)；: Algorithm: relative density SG = fluid density / 1000; Kv = flow x sqrt(SG/delta_p); Cv = 1.167 x Kv; design Cv = Cv x 1.3; among the standard bore Cv series take the first value at or above the design Cv as the recommended bore; estimated velocity = flow / (nominal diameter x velocity factor).
map.按流量、压差与介质密度计算 Cv/Kv: Compute Cv/Kv from flow, differential pressure and fluid density
map.按估算流速校核所选通径: Check the chosen bore with the estimated velocity
map.反算既有阀门 Cv 判断开度与调节性能: Back-calculate the Cv of an existing valve to judge opening and regulating performance
map.输出 Cv/Kv 换算与选型建议: Output the Cv/Kv conversion and selection advice
map.调节阀选型：由流量、压差与介质密度算 Cv/Kv 并选通径: Control valve selection: compute Cv/Kv from flow, differential pressure and fluid density, and select a bore
map.口径校核：用估算流速判断所选通径是否合适: Check the bore: use the estimated velocity to judge whether the chosen nominal diameter is appropriate

map.输入流量与阀前后压差: Enter the flow and the pressure differential across the valve
map.输入介质密度（或相对密度）: Enter the fluid density (or specific gravity)
map.点击计算，读取所需 Cv/Kv: Click Calculate to read the required Cv/Kv
map.按 1.3 倍余量选择阀门通径: Choose the valve bore with a 1.3x margin
map.用流速校核所选通径是否合适: Use the velocity to check whether the chosen bore is appropriate
map.Kv 为公制（m³/h、1bar 水）、Cv 为英制（US gal/min、1p: Kv is metric (m3/h, 1bar water) while Cv is imperial (US gal/min, 1psi), and Cv = 1.167 x Kv; confirm which convention the manufacturer uses
map.设计 Cv 常乘 1.3~2.0 留开度余量，避免长期大开度导致调节性能变差: The design Cv is often multiplied by 1.3 to 2.0 to leave opening margin, so the valve does not sit at a large opening for long and lose regulating performance
map.选型须结合阀权度与可调比校核: Selection must be checked against valve authority and turn-down ratio
map.高黏度、闪蒸/汽蚀工况须特殊修正，必要时选防汽蚀阀内件: High viscosity and flashing or cavitating conditions need special corrections; consider anti-cavitation valve trim where necessary
map.Kv 和 Cv 有什么区别？: What's the Difference Between Kv and Cv?
map.Kv 是国际单位制流量系数（m³/h，压差 1bar、介质为水）；Cv 是英制（: Kv is the SI flow coefficient (m3/h at a 1bar differential with water) and Cv is imperial (US gal/min at 1psi). The conversion is Cv = 1.167 x Kv, so always confirm which one the manufacturer's data uses.
map.为什么设计 Cv 要乘 1.3？: Why Multiply the Design Cv by 1.3?
map.为阀门开度与工况波动留余量，避免阀门长期在过大开度工作导致调节性能变差。调节型阀: It leaves margin for valve opening and operating fluctuations, so the valve does not sit at too large an opening for long periods and lose regulating performance. Control valves are usually sized at 1.3 to 2.0 times the calculated Cv, then checked against valve authority and turn-down ratio.
